description: This file implements serialization logic for handling object references within the Orleans framework. It provides methods for writing, reading, and tracking object references during serialization and deserialization, including support for null references, object markers, and reference integrity.

classes.name: ReferenceCodec
classes.description: A static class providing methods to serialize and deserialize object references, ensuring object identity and reference integrity during the serialization process.

methods.name: MarkValueField
methods.description: Marks the session that the upcoming field is a value type to handle reference semantics correctly.

methods.name: TryWriteReferenceFieldExpected
methods.description: Attempts to write a reference for a value that has already been serialized, using a static expected type.

methods.name: TryWriteReferenceField
methods.description: Attempts to write a reference for a value, including expected type information if it has been tracked.

methods.name: TryWriteReferenceField
methods.description: Attempts to write a reference for a value, with explicit expected and actual types, for derived or polymorphic types.

methods.name: WriteNullReference
methods.description: Writes a null reference indicator to the serialized output.

methods.name: ReadReference
methods.description: Reads a reference from the serialized input, returning the referenced object, handling nulls.

methods.name: ReadReference
methods.description: Reads and resolves a referenced object from the input stream, throwing if the reference is not found.

methods.name: DeserializeFromMarker
methods.description: Handles deserialization of objects that are referenced via a marker, potentially recursively deserializing nested references.

methods.name: RecordObject
methods.description: Records an object as referenced in the current serialization session.

methods.name: CreateRecordPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates a placeholder reference ID for objects that cannot be immediately deserialized.
